chunk_map.heading: Leave it out of the plan and the agent decides

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "A wrong call about which interviews count spreads into every page written after it." closest to violating: 'the plan' (L4) and 'it' in header resolve to the header's plan and the agent; 'which interviews' is an illustrative example, not a definite back-reference. L8 'the plan' = the numbered list named L6. No pronoun without in-chunk antecedent.
grep for 'lecture|opening|earlier|module|prework' in body L1-9 -> 0 hits; no cross-file pointer.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 carries a self-contained claim: unplanned gaps get decided mid-work and spread; L6 gives the move. Not a wait-state slide.

Header 'Leave it out of the plan and the agent decides' vs L4 'What the plan leaves open, the agent decides halfway through' - body states exactly the header's claim; closest strain is 'it' in header, resolved by L4's 'What the plan leaves open'.

L6 'what it will read, what it will write, and where' is a concrete triple with distinct content, not anaphora; no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; no superlative; no number+retraction; no abstraction-noun stack (L8 'redirect every step after it' is concrete).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: body L1-9 vocabulary: plan, agent, go-ahead, pages, interviews - ordinary register. Closest: 'inside work already moving' (L4) is plain idiom, not repo dialect. Maintainer-block 'Runtime guard' not on slide.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body L1-9 -> 0; no bold, within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: curriculum/lectures/apt101-only-what-you-tell-it.md includes look-before-it-writes (grep -rln hit); slide file under a lecture reaches the deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or ordinal references

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/look-before-it-writes.md -> OK, 1 files, no page-geometry pointers. L8 'every step after it' is plan-step order, not page geometry.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/look-before-it-writes.md -> slides: 1, oversized: 0, within 210 words / 6 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture slide; L1 header is a claim ('Leave it out of the plan and the agent decides'), as the lecture-heading convention requires.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'One correction to the plan can redirect every step after it.' closest to a kicker (class c), but it adds the leverage payoff (why the review gate pays) rather than restating the header, which is about omission; L4/L6 carry mechanism and move. Each bullet adds something.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header-rename provenance note or body-untouched rename signal; STATUS records a fresh squint build, not a retitle
